name: premise-check
description: Catches claims about libraries, frameworks and versions made from stale training data, and makes them get checked against current sources.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: nudge: make the agent re-check before it finishes. verify: an independent subagent checks and reports back. escalate: nudge first, verify if the agent ignores the nudge. off: only the system-prompt reminder.

checkerModel.title: Checker model
checkerModel.description: Model alias or id the verifying subagent runs on.
